mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_price_failure_ledger (sample_key, signal_day_key, rule_version, rule_spec_hash, sample_role, matched_signal_id, origin_assessment_id, origin_observation_id, symbol, market, stock_name, stratum, source_date, source_time_epoch_ms, available_time_epoch_ms, available_at, signal_price, feature_snapshot_json, match_score, controls_finalized, status, row_version) VALUES (#{sampleKey}, #{signalDayKey}, #{ruleVersion}, #{ruleSpecHash}, #{sampleRole}, #{matchedSignalId}, #{originAssessmentId}, #{originObservationId}, #{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{stratum}, #{sourceDate}, #{sourceTimeEpochMs}, #{availableTimeEpochMs}, #{availableAt}, #{signalPrice}, #{featureSnapshotJson}, #{matchScore}, #{controlsFinalized}, #{status}, #{rowVersion})
mapper.select: SELECT signal.* FROM stock_watch_price_failure_ledger signal WHERE signal.rule_version = #{ruleVersion} AND signal.sample_role = 'SIGNAL' AND signal.controls_finalized = FALSE ORDER BY signal.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM stock_watch_price_failure_ledger WHERE matched_signal_id = #{matchedSignalId} AND sample_role = 'CONTROL' ORDER BY match_score ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_price_failure_ledger SET controls_finalized = TRUE, row_version = row_version + 1, gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion} AND sample_role = 'SIGNAL' AND controls_finalized = FALSE

UPDATE stock_watch_price_failure_ledger SET status = #{status}, entry_observation_id = #{entryObservationId}, entry_source_time_epoch_ms = #{entrySourceTimeEpochMs}, entry_source_date = #{entrySourceDate}, entry_price = #{entryPrice}, t1_trade_date = #{t1TradeDate}, t1_open = #{t1Open}, t1_high = #{t1High}, t1_low = #{t1Low}, t1_close = #{t1Close}, t1_max_drawdown_pct = #{t1MaxDrawdownPct}, t1_close_return_pct = #{t1CloseReturnPct}, t1_gap_pct = #{t1GapPct}, t1_max_upside_pct = #{t1MaxUpsidePct}, t1_drawdown_5_hit = #{t1Drawdown5Hit}, data_quality_reason = #{dataQualityReason}, matured_at = #{maturedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1, gmt_modify = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_watch_price_failure_ledger WHERE rule_version = #{ruleVersion} AND sample_role = 'SIGNAL' AND status = 'MATURE'
